Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activity rows in assay CHEMBL1614364. Join activities to assays on assay_id and to molecule_dictionary on molregno. Join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join. Filter where standard_value is not null and standard_relation equals '='. Return all matching rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
